description: Proof of the orbit-trace identity (Tier 1.B): tr_M(β_{Z,N}) is invariant under same-species nucleon permutations σ ∈ S_Z × S_N. Lemma 1 (word invariance — per-species intra-blocks identical, interfaces σ-invariant) + Lemma 2 (Markov M1 conjugation-invariance, confirmed by cyclic-rotation tr_M agreement < 1e-40 at 50 dps). Corrects the roadmap's |orbit|·tr_M(rep) to tr_M(β)=tr_M(rep).

conclusion.roadmap_correction: tr_M(beta)=tr_M(rep); |orbit| is reduction-tree dedup, NOT a trace multiplier
